{% autoescape off %}# {{ ref.title }}

> Read-only JSON API over the Rubin alert objects this service has ingested and their positional crossmatches against {% for cat in ref.catalogs %}{{ cat.name }} ({{ cat.release }}){% if not forloop.last %}, {% endif %}{% empty %}no catalogs{% endfor %} within {% if ref.radius_arcsec is not None %}{{ ref.radius_arcsec }} arcsec{% else %}a radius that is not configured{% endif %}. Look up objects by diaObjectId, sky position, or TNS name; count before fetching; every response carries the provenance a methods section needs.

Service version {{ ref.service_version }}; contract version {{ ref.contract_version }}. Every fact here is read from the live configuration of the running service.

- Crossmatch: {{ ref.nearest_rule }}
- Units and frames: {{ ref.conventions }}
- Reliability cuts (minimum LSST reliability per broker): {{ ref.cuts_text }}. A broker-enforced value is declared by the maintainer, not observed by this service.
- Not in this service: {{ ref.caveats.not_in_service }}
- Coincidence: {{ ref.caveats.coincidence }}
- Paging: {{ ref.caveats.paging }}
- Limits per request: {{ ref.limits.max_ids }} IDs; {{ ref.limits.max_positions }} positions and TNS names together; radius at most {{ ref.limits.max_cone_radius_arcsec }} arcsec; {{ ref.limits.max_objects_per_position }} objects per position and {{ ref.limits.max_objects_per_request }} per request; a {{ ref.limits.request_budget_seconds }} s budget. Over a maximum is a 400 naming the parameter.
- Workflow: read the describe endpoint for catalogs, what catalog_source_id means per catalog, and filterable fields with units; send a lookup with response=count to size a question, then fetch with detail=full for raw catalog values. Each response's provenance block (service_version, crossmatch_radius_arcsec, catalogs with releases, reliability_cuts) is the methods sentence.
- Errors are JSON with a fixed snake_case code and retryable; a malformed batch entry fails only that entry.

- [API reference in HTML]({{ ref.urls.html }}): the same reference for people.
